hotel.name: Il San Corrado di Noto Resort

verified_facts.text: Il San Corrado is about 20 minutes from Noto.
verified_facts.excerpt: Only 20 minutes from Noto

verified_facts.text: A complimentary shuttle runs to Noto and to the hotel's private beach club.
verified_facts.excerpt: A complimentary shuttle runs to both Noto and the hotel’s private beach club

verified_facts.text: The estate was once the private residence of a prince.
verified_facts.excerpt: This ivory stone beauty was once the private residence of Prince Nicolac

verified_facts.text: Architect Corrado Papa adapted the old masseria structures for modern use.
verified_facts.excerpt: where ancient, near-sacred structures are gently eased into modern relevancy by architect Corrado Papa

verified_facts.text: The family's private 19th-century chapel was left untouched.
verified_facts.excerpt: private 19th-century chapel, are left untouched and congruous with new additions

verified_facts.text: An orchid-clad library displays Helmut Newton prints.
verified_facts.excerpt: an orchid-clad library showcasing Helmut Newton prints is a smooth, shady refuge from the midday sun

verified_facts.text: Interiors are carved from Modican stone.
verified_facts.excerpt: one carved with contemporary flair from Modican stone

verified_facts.text: Sun loungers and rooms line two large pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Sun loungers and rooms line two enormous pools

verified_facts.text: The pool villas sit among the olive groves and match the suites' design, adding private pools and greater privacy.
verified_facts.excerpt: Scattered amongst the olive groves in cubic form, the pool villas mirror the main hotel suites in all design matters, just with pools and an immense level of privacy.

verified_facts.text: Principe di Belludia is the hotel's polished restaurant, with a window onto the kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: In polished Principe di Belludia, a window peels back an orderly kitchen

verified_facts.text: CasaPasta is a more relaxed poolside restaurant with a pizza oven and outdoor grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: CasaPasta is a more relaxed, poolside affair

verified_facts.text: CasaPasta's chefs work around a large pizza oven and outdoor grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chefs dance around an enormous pizza oven and outdoor grill

verified_facts.text: The spa has a sauna, a steam room and a cold-water bucket shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: the spa is a cozy refuge with a sauna, steam room, and (for a courageous few) a cold-water bucket shower

verified_facts.text: Spa massages and facials use chemical-free Sodashi products.
verified_facts.excerpt: Skilled, nimble fingers work chemical-free Sodashi products on weary muscles during full body massages and facials.

verified_facts.text: The Technogym fitness center overlooks the main pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Technogym-adorned fitness center is no subterranean afterthought, but enjoys a privileged spot overlooking the vast main pool

verified_facts.text: There is a tennis court on the grounds among olive and citrus groves.
verified_facts.excerpt: ancient olive and citrus groves interrupted only by a neat tennis court

verified_facts.text: The hotel organizes excursions such as visiting hidden villages in the Hyblaean Mountains with a local guide, or truffle hunting.
verified_facts.excerpt: such as exploring hidden villages in the Hyblaean Mountains with a local guide or truffle hunting

verified_facts.text: The hotel holds outdoor cinema evenings and yoga classes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Back at the hotel, outdoor cinema evenings and yoga classes abound.

verified_facts.text: The food concept also caters to vegetarians and vegans.
verified_facts.excerpt: deliziando il palato anche di vegetariani o vegani

verified_facts.text: Tea, herbal teas and snacks are served in the afternoon.
verified_facts.excerpt: nelle ore del pomeriggio, con tè, tisane e gustosi spuntini

verified_facts.text: There are no stairs in the hotel and it suits wheelchairs, but the surrounding paths are uneven.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are no stairs in this hotel, and while the stone labyrinth is good for wheelchairs, the surrounding paths are uneven.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is geared toward adults, particularly in the communal spaces.
verified_facts.excerpt: Il San Corrado is geared towards the grown-ups, particularly in the communal spaces.

verified_facts.text: Child-friendly areas are kept clearly separate from adult spots.
verified_facts.excerpt: clearly separating the child-friendly areas from the more adult spots

verified_facts.text: The hotel uses solar panels and its own well and water recycling system to water the gardens.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel uses its own well and water recycling system to water the gardens

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a rural location.
verified_facts.excerpt: rural location allows guests to explore the region at their own pace

unresolved.text: Guests can practice yoga with an instructor outdoors, in the yoga pavilion, on the private beach or under the stars.
